## MAP source and status cover

The exact MAP source manifest is manager verification metadata. Its digest is
`bd3f172f8bb1e17bf95fde034ad76632439c766ef89b0a992361b9e6d79ada0a`;
its external sidecar and the freeze record bind the wrapper, six modules and
three proposed boundary/profile sources. Frozen authority supersedes historical
candidate-status text without changing its bytes. No ambient/latest Registry
file substitutes for the exact manifest-bound MAP generation.

The forward one-hot containing-pixel estimator is authoritative. Its reverse
model-to-sample projection is outside MAP's selection and remains a FRUIT-method
choice. Required response/uncertainty states are not guarantees of numerical
availability. Original-footprint exposure is neither model support nor repeated
iteration count. The first method may not infer a unity or precision coefficient
or choose `coverage_cut` from software defaults.

## Exclusions

Exclude all historical code/configuration, the internal dossier, method-record
recovery table, manager permission table/ledger, sidebar and its disposition,
whole owner archive, `inputs/manager/`, all direct `inputs/authority/jinc/`
sources, tests, audits, repairs, empirical outcomes and performance evidence.
The generic FRUIT core's existing JINC boundary statements stay unchanged;
they do not admit a JINC specialization into this first-method task.

The source firewall applies to content and links. Copied immutable scientific
sources retain context links for provenance only; permissions are not transitive.
Before a future author launch, incorporate exact owner answers, verify the
isolated input set, and obtain the corresponding explicit authority under the
then-current program gates.
